mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) relative to their prior month values indicates a strengthening housing sector and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 1% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the 2017 base (100) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE declines from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL value exceeding 240 (index) signals overheating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL > 240.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth economic regime, a monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the 2017 base (100) signals a potential slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-growth expansion periods, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 100.
